verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules are a fair question for a cloud browser automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined rules, triggers, or event-driven actions. It covers only API-invoked sessions, agents, scraping, and sandboxes. Automatic CAPTCHA solving is a built-in session feature, not a user-defined event rule, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
